question: How do I add an API Reference to my Fern documentation?
ground_truth: To add an API Reference to your Fern documentation, run `fern init --openapi /path/to/openapi.yml` to create an `openapi.yml` file in your project, then reference it in your `docs.yml` file by adding `- api: "API Reference"` under the navigation section.

metadata.cited_context: Add an API Reference by adding an OpenAPI Specification to your project. `fern init --openapi /path/to/openapi.yml` This will create an `openapi.yml` file in your project. You can reference this file in your `docs.yml` file by adding an api block. `navigation: - api: "API Reference"`
